summary: Standardize audit evidence storage and managed lifecycle routing

delivery.outcome: Define a discoverable audit-evidence storage profile and managed lifecycle routing without new storage services or stronger publication gates.
nonGoals: No historical audit migration, deletion or script replay.
No new product controller, mandatory Planfile rollout, unrelated repository edits or approval bypass.

architecture.decision: Extend the existing new-project procedural and lifecycle documentation. Keep logs formatting, private execution evidence, durable reports and ticket state under their existing owners; explicitly label missing product automation.
architecture.rollback: Revert the bounded documentation changes; existing audit paths and receipts remain unchanged.

validation.evidence: Review the storage matrix, XDG semantics, relative-index constraints and no-migration/no-authority boundaries.
Existing registration conformance remains valid; document verified project readback and transport recovery without inventing controller availability.
Hub scope and existing lifecycle admission remain valid; changed document links, normative versions and explicit manual enforcement mappings are checked.
